narr: Showers and thunderstorms moved through the Ozarks through the late morning of the 30th. The highest rainfall totals occurred along and north of Interstate 44, with isolated accumulations over two inches occurring from Nevada to Versailles.
ev: Heavy rainfall caused Joplin Creek to overtop Murphy Boulevard west of Main Street in Joplin.
Heavy rainfall caused water to overtop the road near the intersection of Fairview Road and Shamrock Lane making the road impassable.
Excessive rainfall caused water over the road at a low area near the intersection of Black Cat Road and Belle Center Road.
